$comment: One decision record. 4-9 KB before compression, 140 M a month, 7 years.
The three things to look at:
1. There is no `fired_rule_ids` list. There is a 10 x uint64 bitset.
Fixed width, 80 bytes, and per-rule detail is DERIVED at read time by
joining against the pinned generation's rule catalogue. Storing the
feature values each rule tested, per rule, would be storing the same
numbers up to nine times on a genuinely fraudulent payment.
2. The applicable population is 28 bytes of inputs plus an 8-byte digest,
3. Everything needed to replay is here, and nothing here is a pointer

generation.$comment: toolchain is recorded because a replay in 2031 that rebuilds from pinned source on a different numba is not obviously the same computation. Doc 08 s8 records the artefact id and not the toolchain that produced it; over 540 days that is not enough.

feature_vector_ref.$comment: Inline in the record, not a reference — the store is mutable and will not hold these values in 540 days. Shown abbreviated.

applicability.$comment: 28 bytes of inputs + an 8-byte digest. The set is recomputed on replay and checked against the digest.

applied.note: in scope but inert on this event — the card model was absent

overlays.$comment: ADJ-0042 is recorded although it did nothing. That is how an analyst confirms her scoping did what she intended; a mis-scoped overlay's only symptom is an absence.

$rendered_for_humans.note: MS-0208 fired at R4 550 (overlaid). At its base threshold of R6 500 it would not have fired on R12 400 — it would have. Shown here as fired_on_overlay because the *bank band* condition passed only at the overlaid band. Derived from the pinned catalogue, not stored.

shadow.$comment: Separate object, separate field names. A downstream consumer that unions this with `firings` gets a schema error, not a wrong answer.

resolution_trace.$comment: MS-0208 and MS-0311 both asked for a hold-adjacent action; severity 4 beat severity 3 at the first tie-break key, so priority and family precedence never ran. That is what 'every resolution point that discriminated' means, and it is the answer to 'why did my rule not take effect although it fired'.

counterfactual.$comment: Same action, different source. Without the overlay stack MS-0208 would not have fired and MS-0311 would have carried the hold. The overlay bought nothing on this event — which is exactly the kind of finding the monthly forum exists for, and it is only visible because the base resolution ran too.

dispatch.$comment: SCAM-1 was over its depth threshold. The reroute is recorded, so the SLA breach report can separate 'the rule asked for 15 minutes' from 'the floor could not give it'.

client_communication.rendered_text: We've paused this payment to check it with you. Please call us on the number on the back of your card.
client_communication.$comment: Deliberately less specific than the internal reason set. The record holds BOTH and the mapping: a complaint is about what the client was told, a representment about what was true.
